Select exact IC50 activity rows for the HDAC6 assay CHEMBL1865. Require canonical SMILES and PubMed-indexed documents. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce SMILES presence. Filter assays by chembl_id CHEMBL1865 and activities by standard_type IC50. Filter docs where pubmed_id IS NOT NULL. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
